apps.name: Mowigun's World
apps.short_description: Imagination Land, a realm of elixir, is beset by robo-animals. Shoot platforms out mid-fall, or blast foes across the screen. Fight atop a speeding orange train ramming flaming boxes, battle a cloning humanoid rhino trapped in a box, or a massive sunflower, etc, as you uncover the robots’ origins.

apps.name: My Galaxy Buddy
apps.short_description: Pilot a lone UFO in this cozy idle desktop game that lives in the corner of your screen. Discover randomly generated planets, extract rare resources, uncover strange artifacts, and build your collection one world at a time.

apps.name: Necromancer’s Domain
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy dungeon management game where you rule as a necromancer. Build and defend your dungeon, resurrect fallen enemies as undead soldiers and workers, research forbidden magic, and expand your domain across the world.

apps.name: PADEL IMPACT PRO
apps.short_description: Grab a racket and step onto the court. Play solo against AI, host private lobbies with friends, or battle online — smash, lob, and bounce shots off the glass in the world's hottest racket sport.

apps.name: Party Tycoon: Takeover
apps.short_description: Build a nightlife empire one event at a time. Book the night, stock the bars, open the doors, and turn a rough room into the hottest venue in town. But most important: have fun!

apps.name: Please Buy My Junk!
apps.short_description: An Item Shop Tycoon Game!! Hunt critters, collect their junk and sell it off to some very cool customers that come into your little shop! Become rich and powerful and cool in this unique fantasy world!!

apps.name: Pretty Mecha
apps.short_description: Pretty Mecha is an RPG / platformer game set in space aboard the ever-venturing ship, the Streamus. Populated by numerous friendly allies, a rebel team is already in place, and Corp has no choice but to join them to save Earth from further destruction by the Shultz Army.

apps.name: Ravenous Greed
apps.short_description: Trapped in the body of a raven, Pacer begins his quest to restore his human form. He must collect all of the treasures to fill his vault with coins! Only with enough wealth can he finally overcome the curse.

apps.name: ReDead Frontline
apps.short_description: ReDead Frontline is a post-apocalyptic idle defense game where the zombie outbreak has already won. Trapped in a time loop, you hold the line, recruit survivors, upgrade weapons, deploy drones, study enemies, and reset after each defeat to return stronger and break the cycle.

apps.name: REM
apps.short_description: Sometimes the deepest sleep is the only way to wake up. Plug into the REM simulation in this 1st-person psychological narrative game where Neo is trapped in the hum of the past. Navigate surreal dreams and face the darkness of your mind to reach Talya. Don't forget to wake up.

apps.name: RenewCity
apps.short_description: Small budget. Hard choices. No perfect fixes. Revitalize real neighborhoods in Detroit, Seoul, and Leipzig, and find out whether you helped the people who live there or replaced them.

apps.name: Rival Waves
apps.short_description: Tower defense where you fight as the hero. Draft roguelike skills every level, hold your lane through 21 waves of monsters and bosses, and send creeps to crush your rival's King. Eight heroes, PvP in 1v1, 2v2 and 4v4, and solo or co-op against the AI.

apps.name: RPG Bouncers
apps.short_description: Everyone carries a rocket launcher. Your own rockets launch you; everyone else's hurt. Bounce across 11 destructible voxel arenas, knock rivals into the void or the sea, and play with 16 online, 4 on one screen, or against bots in a lost 2009 indie arcade shooter.

apps.name: RUN!
apps.short_description: Scavenge, deliver the loot and reach extraction… while your friends hunt you down! RUN! is a 3D multiplayer survival horror game with its own unique style, where survivors face armed drones and a saucer-piloting alien in matches built around teamwork, chases and chaos.

apps.name: Sarmatian Heroes
apps.short_description: Sarmatian Heroes is a turn-based strategy RPG where you explore the world, develop heroes, command armies, build fortified cities, and fight tactical battles on hex-based battlefields in an alternate-history setting.

apps.name: Savage Resurrection
apps.short_description: The rebirth of the classic action FPS / RTS hybrid "Savage 1" is here! Experience fast-paced combat and cunning strategic gameplay in glorious Unreal 4 environments. Engage in epic 16v16 front-line combat, or take Command to outplay and outmaneuver your team's way to victory.

apps.name: Shape Fulfillment Center
apps.short_description: Sublime Shape Fulfillment Experience

apps.name: She is in Silence
apps.short_description:
A visual novel featuring expressive sequences brought to life through a wealth of AI-generated animation.The game includes multiple endings.
At the end of the game, you will confess to something.
It is up to you to decide what that "something" truly is.

apps.name: Skyreap
apps.short_description: Explore a forgotten archipelago of floating islands. Gather resources, build and automate production, and link islands into a thriving trade network, until the sky belongs to you.

apps.name: Slots & Guns
apps.short_description:
Spin. Shoot. Survive.
Enter a strange cardboard world where every duel is a gamble. Spin your revolver to build your abilities, outplay mysterious opponents, and fight your way through a world full of secrets.

apps.name: StackProsper
apps.short_description: Drop one card onto another and watch a 13th-century kingdom grow. Gather, build and raise your people, survive the seasons and hostile neighbors, then win by conquering their capitals or completing a grand cathedral.

apps.name: Station Between
apps.short_description: A cozy, small-scale, coffee shop and talking simulator. As a raccoon barista, you have a gift for warming people’s hearts: brew coffee, match flavours to your customers and discover their stories. Help travellers sort out their final errands before they catch their last train.

apps.name: Stream Snipers
apps.short_description: Stream Snipers is a multiplayer battle game about doing ANYTHING for content! Fight your friends for followers, grow your totally real audience, get rich taking on ridiculous challenges from chat, and strive to stay alive in the deadliest live competition.

apps.name: TALES: INK GUARDIAN
apps.short_description: A 2D roguelike where ink and plants define your fate. Combine skills, relics, and plant abilities to craft a unique build every run. Purify the Void Ink threatening to consume the world — because no two runs, and no two strategies, are ever the same.

apps.name: The Official's Path
apps.short_description: A satirical life simulation of China's civil service system. Rise from a lowly clerk to a powerful official, navigate corruption and political intrigue, make choices that shape your career, and discover where your principles end. 14 endings, 1000+ events, 45 years of modern Chinese history.

apps.name: the taikon company
apps.short_description: Be the dreamer-in-chief of a young space company: set wild goals, push rockets out the door, and watch them reach orbit, the Moon and a space station. Ships from three eras, inside and out. A realistic spaceflight sandbox in a very early, very honest alpha: bugs included, curiosity welcome.

apps.name: The Wee Pier
apps.short_description: A cosy idle fishing game on a Scottish island. Fish from a stone pier while the bites come on their own, level eight skills, hire four hands, then mend an old creel boat and take her out to new grounds. Five Summers with a proper ending, 121 catches to log, and no timers or ways to fail.

apps.name: Thorny Times
apps.short_description: Lead a mercenary company through story-driven fantasy scenarios. Capture castles, manage scarce resources, evolve your fighters, and solve puzzle-like turn-based battles where positioning matters more than brute force.

apps.name: TowerBits8
apps.short_description: Towerbit8 is a tower defense game with platformer mechanics, where you must defeat waves of enemies to build your defenses using directional turrets and defeat the 8 bosses that rule the invading monsters.

apps.name: Treeworld: Sky Haven
apps.short_description: "Treeworld: Sky Haven" is an idle role-playing game featuring a cute art style, where players can form their own teams and freely explore a charming world.

apps.name: Tupi: The Legenda of Arariboia
apps.short_description: Recruit powerful spirits, discover devastating combat synergies, and fuse new creatures in this tactical roguelite RPG. Customize spirit abilities during each expedition, experiment with unique team builds, and grow stronger with village upgrades. Inspired by Shin Megami Tensei and Hades.

apps.name: Turbo Groove
apps.short_description: Your music is the track. Pick a song and Turbo Groove turns it into a road, with bends, drops and jumps on the beat. Drift, hit the notes and dodge traffic in an arcade racer where every song is a new level.

apps.name: University of Magic: Faculty of Witches
apps.short_description: You play as the newly appointed head of the Witchcraft Faculty at a prestigious magic university. While teaching and guiding students, you will also have the opportunity to build romantic relationships with three of the most talented witches.

apps.name: Voenkomat 8
apps.short_description: The endless Gigakhrushchevka. A Soviet enlistment office and you are here to pass the primary selection for liquidators of the Samosbor aftermath. Stay alert. Spotted an anomaly? Mark it at the terminal and report to the Watchman. One mistake and you start over. The Watchman waits on floor eight.

apps.name: Walk Hero
apps.short_description: Go forward. Kill enemies. Collect loot. Get stronger. And again. An unusual mix of genres will allow you to focus solely on the choice of equipment and upgrades.

apps.name: When We Become Shining Stars
apps.short_description:
“They say we all become stars someday.”
A gently bittersweet starlit puzzle game where you guide departed souls into the night sky.

apps.name: WHUCK Protocol
apps.short_description: Pilot a customizable spacecraft in WHUCK Protocol, a top-down voxel sci-fi roguelite. Survive waves of hostile machines, evolve powerful weapons, defeat massive bosses, and choose when to extract or descend deeper to uncover the legend of WHUCK.

apps.name: バックドロッパーいずな
apps.short_description: How strong can you get with nothing but suplexes? At first, you can only throw one enemy. Keep upgrading, and you'll be able to lift heavier foes and slam entire crowds at once. An incremental game where you keep choosing who to throw next.

apps.name: フルボッコようちえん
apps.short_description:
Spend a cute—and slightly violent—day at kindergarten with Kotomi, your one and only friend.
The 13-year-old free visual novel FULLBOKKO KINDERGARTEN returns as a CLASSIC REMASTER, preserving the artwork and atmosphere of the original release.

apps.name: 天堂奇缘
apps.short_description:
Five girls, one shared life. Who will you fall for?
Different personalities and different ways of connecting can lead each relationship in a completely different direction.
Every response shapes the story, and your choices decide how it all ends.
developers: 杭州维娜斯容颜网络科技有限公司
publishers: 杭州维娜斯容颜网络科技有限公司

apps.name: 畸界：雾城
apps.short_description: A short survival-horror game. With only a compass and a fragmented map, scavenge, fight monsters and seek a way out of a fogbound city that should not exist.

apps.name: 소설 속 악역영애를 구원하는 법
apps.short_description: You've woken up as a novel's hero—but it's the doomed villainess you want to save! Make friends at a magic academy and build your own spell deck in this roguelite RPG meets visual novel. No matter how many times you start over, you're determined to give her a happy ending!

apps.name: Light Up The Town Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
Official soundtrack for Light Up The Town
Composed by Benjamin Squires

apps.name: Sounds of New Babel - MiniLAW: Ministry of Law OST
apps.short_description: MiniLAW: Ministry of Law original soundtrack. All 32 tracks of high-quality mp3 audio featured in game.

apps.name: Alien Covenant In Utero: ALIEN: COVENANT In Utero (Castilian Spanish)
apps.short_description: ALIEN: COVENANT In Utero es una experiencia en realidad virtual, que brinda un encuentro personal y aterradoramente cercano con un Neomorfo alienígena en el instante de su nacimiento.

apps.name: Alien Covenant In Utero: VR-видео «ЧУЖОЙ: В УТРОБЕ»
apps.short_description: Alien: Covenant in Utero (VR-видео «ЧУЖОЙ: В УТРОБЕ») -  это погружение в виртуальную реальность по мотивам легендарной франшизы «Чужой». Вы окажитесь наедине с неоморфом чужог
